text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a day out, I accompany Agnes
Digital to a
shopping mall.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Remember how I talked about the
release event
tied to the photo books I
bought before? Turns
out I won! So, we
need to prepare.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Deodorant.
choice_data_list: What are you going to buy?
What are you going to buy?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Um, don't you get sweaty at these
kinds of
things?! I know I can't help it,
but I get all hot and
flustered every
time!
choice_data_list: Do we need it for the event?
Is that needed for the event?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And I don't want the people around me
getting a
whiff of that! Or, heavens
forbid, have one of my
oshis smell it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Then, people will start spreading rumors
that Uma
simps are stinky!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't be able to live with myself!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
On another point, recently in all these
races, I've
had lots of opportunities to
be near other
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So I need to be very careful about what

deodorant I choose. I'm using unscented
right
now, but I've been thinking it'd be
nice to find
something that kills all
smells...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Like something that would get rid of the
scent of
my shampoo and conditioner as
well. I wanna be
totally odorless so I can
better sense the
fragrance of my Umas.
Totally odorless, huh? Hm. Interesting.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyagh! Tachyon?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, here I am walking around,
minding my
own business, when the most
intriguing idea grace
my ears—a
deodorant that makes you completely

odorless... Shall I try my hand at it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In a previous study, I had managed to
create a
liquid with very strong
deodorizing properties.
Improving said
solution might produce something
akin
to what you're in search of.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa... Look at your eyes gleaming
with excitement...
So wuvely...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
On that note, I'd like to collect some
data on you
while you're producing
sweat... You don't mind,
do you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Not at all! Have at it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh... That's a good answer.
Well, if
you'll excuse me for now...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniff... Hmmm, I see...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyaaargyahg!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Okay, next I'd like to observe your
physical
reactions and the quantity of
sweat produced
while under the
conditions in which you would use

deodorant.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Huh. It doesn't appear Digital is capable of responding at the moment. Well then, Trainer, what situation do you think would be most appropriate?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Before and after a race, you say? In
other words,
a situation that produces
both feelings of passion
and anxiety.
choice_data_list: I think it's before or after the race.
...Somewhere Digital wants to go right now, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I know of an environment
that can
replicate a similar state and
assist us in obtaining
data a great deal
faster than running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Agnes Tachyon leads us to... an

amusement park roller coaster.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm sitting next to Tachyon?! O-oh, be
still, my
beating heart!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Sh-she's so close... Pant, pant... Oh... m-m-my heart! Wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Your breathing is quite irregular... So tell
me,
have you begun sweating?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Too... close! Your hair is nearly brushing
my
cheek! Nononono! Touching
Umamusume is off
limits! But there's
nowhere to ruuuuunnngyahhh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear it, Trainer? When the
coaster
dropped, Tachyon let out a little
gasp!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Her intellectual demeanor slipped for
just a split
second! Do you know how
rare of a moment that
was?! My heart
won't stop pounding!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Wonderful job, Digital! That

heightened state of yours didn't waver
for a
second—before, during, or after
the ride!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's fascinating how far beyond the norm
you are!
Do you have a limitless supply
of endorphins?!
AHAHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Squeal! Oh, Tachyon... You sound like you're having so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... I'm itching to get back and
analyze your
reactions! So, if you don't
mind, I'll be off!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm... so... happy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I catch Agnes Digital as she falls under a
fainting
spell. It seems the two of them
had a really good
time. What more could
I ask for?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Agnes Digital comes to
me with
a deodorant cream in hand,
happily reporting the
exceptional
quality of Agnes Tachyon's work.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A place she wants to go to, hmm? Then
let us
wake her up if you think such a
location will
replicate the state of
excitement that sometimes
overcomes
her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... I wasn't expecting this from you,
Digital.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I chose it because the cakes are really
good. You
don't like places like this?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say that. If it is demanded of
me, I'll
say it all depends on what's on
the menu.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as the cake and tea we order
arrives,
Agnes Tachyon digs in.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Oh my! My entire brain is
inundated in
sweetness!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mmmm, very nice. An eccentric degree
of sugar
content... Very much to my
liking.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The cake's bizarre color dampens one's
appetite,
suppressing the amount of
dopamine released.
Perhaps it's to
prevent the overconsumption of
sugar?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Tachyon... you're so precious how you're enjoying the cake...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, I shouldn't get carried away.
Digital,
let's check your condition.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Face flushed, breathing irregular...
Despite the
relaxed environment you
seem to be in quite the
state of
excitement. Heh-heh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Very good. I think have enough data to
begin
crafting your custom deodorant.
Yes... first off,
I'll need some
antibacterial—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! Look at Tachyon lost in
thought!
Record! I must preserve her
expression on video!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital looks overjoyed as she
watches the
engrossed Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Agnes Digital comes to
me with
a deodorant cream in hand,
happily reporting the
exceptional
quality of Agnes Tachyon's work.
